Callout.Name: Cable Theft in Progress
Callout.Message: Person cutting cable from a substation.
Callout.Advisory: One male with tools, no power lines down.

Script.Line: It is scrap. Scrap is legal.
I did not go near the live side. I know what I am doing.
The cable was already down. It was on the ground when I got here.

Lines.Approach: He is cutting the cable off the wall. Do not touch the metalwork.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
